purpose: Create the FT-001 persistence baseline for local identity, membership, and sessions without implementing adjacent product features.
success_outcome: Later FT-001 tasks can use deterministic Account, FarmMembership, and LocalSession relational records with native UUID identity, exact nullability/checks/login uniqueness/non-cascading relations/indexes, token_hash-only storage, and an explicit deferred Farm FK handoff.

commands: Check changed code preserves linked Foundation Runtime Substrate, Foundation Data Substrate, Foundation Smoke API when relevant, and Evidence Redaction contracts or records a blocker.
Check FT-001 migration uses the Foundation Data Substrate DB/session/Alembic path and creates only FT-001-owned tables/indexes.

Inspect model and migrated PostgreSQL metadata for exact table/column names, native UUID, timestamptz, nullability/defaults, status/role/auth checks, normalized login uniqueness, RESTRICT Account FKs, deferred farm_id FK absence, exact indexes, and no raw-token column.

Run rollback-scoped PostgreSQL migration/repository smoke covering UUID round-trip, representative pending/active/disabled rows, invalid domain values, active/pending password checks, duplicate normalized login, referenced Account delete rejection, and no farms table creation.
success_checks: The accounts, farm_memberships, and local_sessions models/migration use PostgreSQL native UUID mapped as Python uuid.UUID with application UUIDv4 generation for account_id, membership_id, session_id, account references, and farm_id.

Required text/status/timestamp fields are non-null; password_hash, disabled_at, revoked_at, last_seen_at, and client_label preserve the exact FT-001 nullable rules; created_at/updated_at use non-null timestamptz with server now defaults where specified.

DB CHECK constraints reject invalid account_status, membership_status, role_preset, and auth_method values and enforce active Account => password_hash IS NOT NULL plus pending_activation => password_hash IS NULL without a brittle PHC-prefix check.
login_name persistence uses application strip().lower(), a DB normalized/non-empty check, and exactly one unique B-tree lookup on the stored normalized value.

FarmMembership.account_id and LocalSession.account_id use ON DELETE RESTRICT Account FKs; FarmMembership.farm_id is UUID/non-null with no FT-001 FK or farms table, preserving the explicit FT-002 closure handoff.
The schema has exactly the required unique membership, token_hash, LocalSession account_id, and expires_at indexes without duplicates; LocalSession has no raw session-token field.

A rollback-scoped PostgreSQL migration smoke applies the FT-001 migration through the Foundation Alembic path, inserts/reads representative rows, and proves UUID round-trip, normalization conflicts, checks, FK restrictions, and index behavior.
Migration path creates only FT-001-owned records and does not create Farm, Plant, PlantAccessGrant, public invite, or admin audit behavior.
T3 closure includes /verify PASS, /red-verify semantic-pass, HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: done, and ROLLBACK_RECOVERY_NOTE: present.
evidence_required: native UUID/Python uuid.UUID mapping and UUIDv4 round-trip evidence
column type, nullability, timestamptz, and server-default inspection evidence
status/role/auth-method and active/pending password CHECK evidence
normalized login DB check and single unique lookup evidence
ON DELETE RESTRICT Account FK plus deferred farm_id FK absence evidence
exact uniqueness/index set and no duplicate index evidence
no raw session token field evidence

stop_conditions: Migration would require destructive database operations.
Schema requires unresolved FT-002 or FT-003 ownership decisions.
Implementation requires creating a Farm table or enabling durable FarmMembership creation before FT-002 closes the deferred farm_id FK.
Native UUID, normalized login uniqueness, exact DB checks, non-cascading FKs, or the required index set cannot be proven on PostgreSQL.
The active-account password_hash invariant or single unique token_hash lookup index cannot be enforced without contradicting the authoritative FT-001 storage contract.
Verification cannot prove token_hash-only session storage.
Implementation contradicts verified FT-000 app/settings/database/session/redaction baseline.
